messages:
nina: rolled out a sandbox PR that changes flag inheritance: child flags can now inherit TTL from parent by default; need safety/telemetry review

omar: why default to inherit? could surprise owners if parent ttl is long and hide cache regressions

nina: goal is to reduce duplication for multi-tenant customers who mirror parent flags. console will show an "inherits ttl" toggle and a small badge, but i want to make sure API/telemetry/rollout are safe

zhou: telemetry ask: emit event `flag.inheritance.toggled` with flag_id, old_behavior, new_behavior, actor, trace_id. increment counter `flag.inherit.updates_total` with env tag

emily-dx: UX: show breadcrumb "inherited from parent <flag-name> (ttl=XYZ)" on flag detail. when creating a child flag require an explicit opt-in checkbox "inherit TTL from parent" and for existing children show a bulk opt-in preview page

nina: API sketch:
```
PATCH /api/v1/flags/:id
Headers: If-Match: "<etag>"  # optimistic lock required
Body: { "inherit_ttl": true }
```
Return 412 on etag mismatch. for bulk ops we'll return an import_id and per-flag status

omar: sampling: tag 1/500 requests with header `x-flag-inherit:true` to help traces. derive metric `cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_inherit` (true/false) and create a short-lived alert if hit-rate difference >10% over 10m

runbook-bot: created task #8120 "inherit-ttl-observe" with checklist template. (automated) :white_check_mark:

zhou: rollout behavior: default bulk opt-in should be staged canary: 2% -> 10% -> 100% with automated hold on thresholds (error_rate + latency + cost delta). console shows stage progress and an explicit "halt" button. snapshot before each stage and a promote API: POST /api/v1/flags/:id/rollout { "stage": 2 }

nina: OK. so implementation plan: 1) make console default to NOT inherit when creating child flags (explicit opt-in) but allow a bulk opt-in flow with staged rollout; 2) emit `flag.inheritance.toggled` events + counter + include `recent_deploy_id` if available; 3) add sampling header `x-flag-inherit` 1/500; 4) require If-Match etag for changes; 5) snapshot before stages and provide revert API

emily-dx: i'll add timeline UI for inheritance changes, a bulk preview diff, and a revert button that unsets inherit_ttl and optionally clears prefix cache

omar: small addition: make the alert threshold configurable per-tenant for large customers to reduce noise

nina: noted. i'll flip sandbox with staged rollout and post staging link. requesting a 15m smoke review after staging deploy tomorrow

emily-dx: +1 for the smoke check, will prepare quick UX checklist

zhou: don't forget to log a `flag.event.context` entry tying changes to deploys if a deploy occurred in the last 20m so we can avoid misattribution in alerts

nina: will include that. thanks everyone :)
